# Contract fixtures and provenance

These are synthetic Phase 0 contract examples, frozen before Phase 1 implementation. `v0.2/*.json` covers completed clean/threshold, partial critical/none/zero, failed and cancelled outcomes. They are hand-authored examples with fixed repository `/src/example`, timestamp, version spelling, counts and policy values; they are not captures of the current engine or proof of actual filesystem inspection. Keep the examples and historical references intact. Current version defaults are `0.2.0-dev`; example version strings do not set executable metadata.

`internal/reporter/schema_contract_test.go` independently validates these example shapes/status/exit combinations. It also rejects invalid enums, counts and malformed contracts. `internal/reporter/testdata/v0.2` contains separate active serializer goldens generated from synthetic `ScanResult` inputs: tests normalize timestamps, and explicitly supplied version/root/coverage data stay fixed. Some manually constructed inputs intentionally retain unknown telemetry; final production accounting is asserted by `TestAcceptance_EffectivePolicyTelemetry` and `TestAcceptance_UnstartedCoverageIsMeasuredZeroWork`, not inferred from these goldens.

Historical `internal/reporter/testdata/v0.1` contains captured v0.1 output/provenance/manifest from the immutable release commit `92843f3c2d9b365dcd6e502fd7bfbe2ac74229fa`, annotated tag object `c194dd9bf4a42e4d58611dcfaad5a6e7c1e43adc`. Do not regenerate it with v0.2 or treat its known silent-error defects as current requirements. Its original module/release namespace and assets remain historical.

All fixtures use synthetic paths and placeholder patterns; never add usable credentials. Canonical ordering comparisons normalize only time and explicitly variable fixture roots/version inputs, never IDs, severity, redaction or omissions. Review fixture changes as contract changes, separately from producer instrumentation. See [scan/result](../../docs/contracts/SCAN-RESULT.md), [JSON](../../docs/contracts/JSON-V0.2.md), [output](../../docs/contracts/OUTPUT.md) and [migration](../../docs/MIGRATING-TO-V0.2.md) contracts.
